# rekordbox 7 OneLibrary sample

`exportLibrary.db` is copied byte for byte from v1vendi/onelibrary,
`viewer/sample/PIONEER/rekordbox/exportLibrary.db` at commit
`02c6f80c802a635c394e733058502ecf28cf9fc9`
(https://github.com/v1vendi/onelibrary). That project says the file is rekordbox 7's own
export output. MIT licence, copyright 2026 v1vendi; the full text is in `LICENSE` here.

SHA-256 `95b4abed6011dfadb8a534d6e98b88a5d444208ea2798da090cbcf1b410a9dff`.

The database names three tracks by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under
Creative Commons: By Attribution. Only their metadata is here, no audio.

`../wal-profile` is synthetic. `builder/tests/make_onelibrary_fixture.py` regenerates it.
